name: ⚔️ Fling Blade Arena [BETA]
desc:
🌟 WELCOME TO FLING BLADE ARENA! 🌟

Get ready for the ultimate battle! Step into the arena, unleash your skills, and prove you have what it takes to be the champion. 🏆

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
⏳ Wait for the epic round to start!
⚔️ Fling & Eliminate other players to dominate the arena.
💰 Collect Coins during the match to earn wealth.
🔥 Unlock Powers & Swords in the shop to become the strongest player!

⭐ SUPPORT THE GAME:
Don't forget to LIKE 👍 and FAVORITE 🌟 the game! Reaching our milestones helps us bring you massive updates, new weapons, and exclusive rewards!

🛠️ Note: Fling Blade Arena is currently in BETA. Any bugs will be quickly fixed during upcoming updates.

🎉 Enjoy the arena and have fun!
